that must appear on the registration line, and it deliberately carries **no line number**: a line number
shifts with any import edit above `RegisterRoutes`, a symbol does not. A missing file, a renamed handler,
or a re-pathed registration still fails; an import shift no longer does. The judgement lives in
`tests/validate-v3-p0-catalogs.mjs` (`validateRouteSource`).
